newsitem.title: UK: LME copper reluctant to move in late trading.
newsitem.headline: LME copper reluctant to move in late trading.

text.p: LME three months copper hovered around the closing kerb level of $2,281, up $24 from Monday, with little movement seen in late inter-office trading on Tuesday.
At 1905 GMT copper was indicated at $2,278/82 after peaking at $2,287 earlier in the session.
Traders said the metals complex lacked the follow through to extend the current mini-technical bounce, and opted instead to consolidate gains.
"With a close on the highs, expect further initial upward challenges towards $2,300 resistance tomorrow," said brokers Rudolf Wolff in its evening report.
"Though overall, we still feel that further base building is required," it said.
Traders said the market was cautious ahead of a strike vote later on Tuesday at Escondida - the world's largest copper mine.
Aluminium was indicated at $1,553, a touch lower than the kerb close at $1,555 which was up just $6 from the previous kerb.
